entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: A Dominarian cryomaster, leader of the Cult of Rimewind, who tried to undo the World Spell.

entities.name: Cult of Rimewind
entities.description: The cult Heidar led, practicing Rimewind magic.

entities.name: Gendrin
entities.description: Heidar's predecessor, accidentally killed by him.

entities.name: Lindra
entities.description: Daughter of Gendrin, killed by Heidar.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: The spell that ended the Ice Age, causing the Thaw.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: Zombie leader of the Order of Stromgald.

entities.name: Garza Zol
entities.description: The vampire queen of Krov, who ordered Heidar assassinated.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: Plague-wracked city ruled by Garza Zol.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: War-beasts buried in the ice of Ronom Glacier and reanimated by the cult.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation that retaliated against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane Heidar tried to plunge into a new Ice Age.

events.summary: Arguing about stopping the Thaw, Heidar accidentally kills Gendrin and takes over as Master of Rimewind.
events.quote: Heidar accidentally killed the old man.

events.summary: Allied with Haakon, Heidar's scholars find the incantations to awaken the Phyrexians at Tresserhorn.
events.quote: Heidar's scholars found the incantations needed to awaken the Phyrexians

events.summary: Heidar allies with Garza Zol for Krovikan elementalists and helps her crush the Balduvian-Kjeldoran-Yavimayan alliance.
events.quote: He allied with Garza Zol , the powerful vampire queen of the plague-wracked city of Krov

events.summary: Heidar activates the Phyrexians against a Balduvian force and executes Lovisa Coldeyes.
Driven mad, Heidar kills Lindra; Garza Zol has assassins kill him.
events.quote: ordered assassins planted in Rimewind to kill the mad wizard

events.summary: Kjeldor and Yavimaya destroy the Phyrexians and rout the cultists; a ritual restores the Thaw.
events.quote: a Yavimayan ritual permanently ended Rimewind's unnatural winter and restored the Thaw to its proper course

relations.quote: As the leader of the Cult of Rimewind
Heidar accidentally killed the old man.
Thanks to a temporary alliance with Haakon
